gallery.title: Gallery
gallery.description: Fourteen original graphic studies move through a spatial carousel. Tidal lines, long days and quiet doorways explore typography, reflection and the rhythm of a rotating interface.

orbit.title: Orbit
orbit.description: Fourteen pastel cards orbit a central Daily Design wordmark inside a phone composition. Dragging, opening and returning a card studies spatial hierarchy, inertia and chromatic edges.

interactive-narrative.title: Interactive Narrative
interactive-narrative.description: A Daily Design D moves through a sequence of interactive scenes. The experiment studies the relationship between camera movement, particles, reflection and the pacing of a scroll-driven story.

spatial-layers.title: Spatial Layers
spatial-layers.description: Three architectural silhouettes share one layered space. Changing viewpoint reveals different structures and makes depth, occlusion and the transitions between orthogonal views visible.

ocean-interface.title: Ocean Interface
ocean-interface.description: A continuous ocean surface connects two interface states. This study explores real-time water, the half-submerged waterline and the shift from an open horizon to underwater typography.

light-studies.title: Light Studies
light-studies.description: A concept study of light as an interface material: focal contrast, bright edges, reflection and the way a moving highlight directs attention.

optic-type.title: Optic Type
optic-type.description: A concept study of typography seen through optical surfaces. Letterforms, counters and edges provide a readable reference for reflection, refraction and distortion.

gesture-studies.title: Gesture Studies
gesture-studies.description: A concept study of direct manipulation. Pointer position, drag distance, release velocity and return motion describe a small vocabulary of tactile interface feedback.

focus-field.title: Focus Field
focus-field.description: A concept study of focus in a dense visual field. Scale, contrast and spacing help one object become prominent while the surrounding context remains legible.

glass-slingshot.title: Glass Slingshot
glass-slingshot.description: A concept study of curved tracks and elastic release. Its subject is the relation between a visible trajectory, pointer motion and the feeling of a controlled landing.

material-lab.title: Material Lab
material-lab.description: A concept study of transparent interface materials. Thickness, edge highlights, chromatic separation and background contrast are treated as independent visual variables.

spatial-notes.title: Spatial Notes
spatial-notes.description: A concept study of interfaces arranged in depth. Frames, layers and overlaps turn spatial relationships into a visual hierarchy that can still be read at a glance.

motion-loop.title: Motion Loop
motion-loop.description: A concept study of repeating movement. The same path can feel calm, mechanical or elastic when its speed profile, phase and pause are changed.

interface-studies.title: Interface Studies
interface-studies.description: A collection of concept notes on interface structure, motion and optical detail. Each note isolates a visible behavior so its cause and response can be studied.

paper-narrative.title: Paper Narrative
paper-narrative.description: A concept study of narrative through layered surfaces. Reveals, overlaps and changes in scale connect separate interface moments without losing their visual continuity.

liquid-feedback.title: Liquid Feedback
liquid-feedback.description: A concept study of responsive surfaces. Displacement, trails and gradual recovery show how a pointer gesture can leave a brief and readable trace.

afterimage.title: Afterimage
afterimage.description: A concept study of temporal traces. A short history of positions makes motion visible and tests the balance between a clear current state and its fading past.

sound-forms.title: Sound Forms
sound-forms.description: A visual concept study of rhythm, repetition and amplitude. No original commercial soundtrack or client performance is claimed for this interface experiment.

color-studies.title: Color Studies
color-studies.description: A concept study of color across translucent layers. Neighboring hues, gradients and the edges between them help reveal how the surface changes what lies behind it.
